title: Like Day and Night: the Two New World Champ Bikes Take Opposite Approaches to the Rainbow Stripes
content:
We dove into the two new rainbow bikes from Colnago and Specialized, as well as a short look back at our favorite rainbow bikes of the past few years.

Read the full article at Like Day and Night: the Two New World Champ Bikes Take Opposite Approaches to the Rainbow Stripes on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
